					Shop				
		Our shop is the perfect place to talk all things kite related! Stocking North Kiteboarding, Mystic, Source Beachwear, EQ Love and more. Selling kites, boards, harnesses, control systems, apparel and accessories. 		
					Watersports				
		Join us on the beach! Here at Source Kiteboarding we provide kitesurf, wingfoil and surf lessons in a fun and relaxed atmosphere. Learn and improve with experienced instructors in a tropical paradise...		
					Events				
		Check out our annual kitesurfing competition - Malibu Kite Wave Contest. Be in to win one of our amazing sponsored prizes or just enjoy the spectacle from the beach...		
					Groups				
		Here at Source, we&#039;re not just a kitesurfing school, we organise and plan group trips to Vietnam. If you&#039;re looking for a tailored group experience, read on...		
					Our Locations				
		Find us at any of our locations below: Shop 139d Nguyen Dinh Chieu, Ham TienWatersports School Pandanus Resort, Khu Pho 5WingfoilThai Hoa Resort 		
									Contact Us
		 Here at Source, we have over 20 years of kitesurfing experience...so be confident in the knowledge that you&#039;re in the best hands with us! We are official distributors of North Kiteboarding and Mystic in Vietnam and only stock and use the best equipment for our customers.Our cosy shop is the best place to hang out after your session. Relive your beach day over a chat and a beer...So join us on the beach or in the shop to begin your Source experience!
